title: Fel Magic
subheader: Volatile power siphoned from abyssal veins
description:
## Origins

Fel magic is a corruptive force that twists living essence and scorches the veil between realms. Unlike other forms of magic, fel cannot be organically created and is instead extracted from the blood of powerful demons.

## Harvest and Use

Warlocks and infernal alchemists bind demonhosts, draining their ichor into runed phials. The blood is then refined through sigil furnaces to distill its volatile charge, producing a bright-green energy that can be infused into weapons, rituals, or cursed engines.

## Consequences

Fel energy leaves a lingering taint: soils ash-gray, flora wilts, and the caster's aura fractures into jagged remnants. The longer the siphoning continues, the more the demon's will presses back through the conduit, demanding tribute or escape.
